title: Task
description: Work task or to-do item with assignee, project association, status, priority, due date, time tracking, and completion information. Used for project management, task tracking, and productivity applications.

project_id.description: Foreign key reference to the project this task belongs to

description.description: Detailed description of the task requirements and objectives

assignee.description: Full name of the person assigned to this task

assignee_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user assigned to this task

status.description: Current task status (e.g., todo, in_progress, review, done, cancelled)

priority.description: Task priority level (e.g., low, medium, high, urgent)

due_date.description: Date by which the task should be completed

estimated_hours.description: Estimated time to complete the task in hours

actual_hours.description: Actual time spent on the task in hours

created_at.description: Timestamp when the task was created

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the task was completed, null if still pending
